Package org.apache.poi.openxml4j.util

Class ZipArchiveFakeEntry

java.lang.Object
java.util.zip.ZipEntry
org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.zip.ZipArchiveEntry
org.apache.poi.openxml4j.util.ZipArchiveFakeEntry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable, Cloneable, org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.ArchiveEntry, org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.EntryStreamOffsets
public final class ZipArchiveFakeEntry extends org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.zip.ZipArchiveEntry implements Closeable
So we can close the real zip entry and still effectively work with it. Holds the (decompressed!) data in memory (or since POI 5.1.0, possibly in a temp file), so close this as soon as you can!
See Also:
  • ZipInputStreamZipEntrySource.setThresholdBytesForTempFiles(int)

    • setMaxEntrySize

      public static void setMaxEntrySize(int maxEntrySize)
      Set the maximum size of a single entry in a zip-file.
      Parameters:
      maxEntrySize - number of bytes at which a zip entry is regarded as too large for holding in memory - defaults to 100_000_000 (approx 100Mb). A value of -1 means the default value is used.
